taxonomy.note: Current Kew treats Rhus trilobata as a synonym of Rhus aromatica var. aromatica; no separate canonical species or variety entry is created.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays natural Purola flora; Travis UT herbarium under older R. aromatica var. flabelliformis; Williamson county flora under R. aromatica.

morphology.look_here_first: Teach under Rhus aromatica: exactly three leaflets, often fan-shaped and lobed/coarsely toothed, on a low suckering shrub.
